endorsements.name: Mohamed Rezgui
endorsements.label: CVE-2022-22773
endorsements.description: The REST API component of TIBCO Software Inc.'s TIBCO JasperReports Server, TIBCO JasperReports Server - Community Edition, TIBCO JasperReports Server - Developer Edition, TIBCO JasperReports Server for AWS Marketplace, TIBCO JasperReports Server for ActiveMatrix BPM, and TIBCO JasperReports Server for Microsoft Azure contains difficult to exploit Reflected Cross Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerabilities that allow a low privileged attacker with network access to execute scripts targeting the affected system or the victim's local system. Affected releases are TIBCO Software Inc.'s TIBCO JasperReports Server: versions 8.0.1 and below, TIBCO JasperReports Server - Community Edition: versions 8.0.1 and below, TIBCO JasperReports Server - Developer Edition: versions 8.0.0 and below, TIBCO JasperReports Server for AWS Marketplace: versions 8.0.1 and below, TIBCO JasperReports Server for ActiveMatrix BPM: versions 7.9.2 and below, and TIBCO JasperReports Server for Microsoft Azure: versions 8.0.1 and below.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 7.7)
